# noplan

> noplan is a workout tracker for iPhone (iOS 18 or later, optional Apple Watch companion). You build your own plan and swap exercises as you go instead of following a fixed program. No account, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases; data stays on the iPhone. AI is optional: Apple's on-device model by default, or Claude or ChatGPT with the user's own API key. Free on the App Store as "noplan Fitness": https://apps.apple.com/app/id6838410863

## Pages

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6838410863): download noplan Fitness for iPhone (free)

- [Feedback](https://no-plan.app/feedback): send feedback or a question to the developer
